brand.name: Smelloff
brand.mission: To create the best fabric odor eliminators engineered specifically for the Indian climate and lifestyle.

products.name: Smelloff ODORSTRIKE Fabric Odor Eliminator Spray
products.description: Pocket-sized fabric odor control mist for clothes. Fabric only. Made for in-between-wash odor emergencies when a shirt, hoodie, jacket or other clothing carries unwanted odor.

claims.claim: Up to 8 hours of odor protection on fabric under normal office/commute conditions

how_to_use: 1. Identify the odor source on the garment.
2. Hold bottle 15–20 cm away from the fabric.
3. 2–3 sprays for a targeted/midday reset; 4–5 sprays for a full shirt; 5–6 sprays for a jacket.
4. Allow approximately 10 seconds to air-dry before wearing.

shipping.cod: ₹60 handling; ₹289 collectable. Dispatched after phone confirmation.
shipping.details: Free standard shipping across India on prepaid UPI.

returns.details: 7-day return window from delivery. Bottle must be at least 80% full and in original packaging. Reverse pickup where serviceable.
